page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9i.32xlarge is a memory-optimized instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs powered by x86_64 Intel Xeon 6982P-C processors operating at a baseline frequency of 3.2 GHz. The instance is equipped with 1024.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for data persistence. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 36 Gbps. There are no bundled GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The hardware configuration represents a high-density resource profile, offering qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that require substantial memory capacity alongside massive parallel processing power without the overhead of local NVMe drives.

Due to its large memory footprint and high core count, the ecs.r9i.32xlarge is suited for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. These include large-scale in-memory databases, big data analytics, enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, and heavy caching layers.
